runtimeDivergences.reason: Canonical Dev must have a distinct installed launcher/visible identity and must route its normal runtime to WITCH_DEV_MAIN rather than silently executing Stable while appearing to be Dev. Issue-scoped task branches may temporarily self-route while under active validation, but must normalize back to WITCH_DEV_MAIN before integration.
acceptance: Canonical WITCH_DEV_MAIN Tampermonkey name and Dock title report the same DEV version identity.
Canonical Dev update/download URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
Canonical manifest-loaded runtime URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
Dev bootstrap fails visibly rather than silently falling back to Stable if its expected core seam disappears.

runtimeDivergences.reason: Architecture work on wd/10-modular-bootstrap now routes the bootstrap core request through the bounded privileged host while keeping the monolithic application core source unchanged. The task branch self-routes launcher/manifest/module URLs so live validation tests the actual architecture branch rather than canonical Dev.
acceptance: Task launcher and manifest identify v1.3.1 / build 1.3.1-host-owned-core-fetch consistently.
Task branch launcher, core, manifest bootstrap, and manifest module URLs resolve to wd/10-modular-bootstrap during isolated validation.
The privileged host exposes no raw GM_* functions page-globally; only diagnostic capability metadata is page-visible.
The bootstrap core request is performed through PRIVILEGED_HOST.requestText rather than a second direct GM_xmlhttpRequest path.
KWWitchDockHostInfo and KWWitchDockDevChannel report host.requestText as the bootstrap transport during live validation.
Existing monolithic core source and behavior remain unchanged through Stage C.
Before integration to WITCH_DEV_MAIN, task-branch URLs are normalized back to the canonical Dev branch and revalidated.

notes: New Dev was created directly from the Stable baseline above.
Governance/documentation files on Dev are intentionally Dev-specific and are not runtime divergences.
Add a runtime divergence only when an open issue/task intentionally requires Dev behavior or module source to differ from Stable.
Issue-scoped task branches may self-route for accurate isolated runtime validation; task-specific routing must not survive canonical integration.
